# DockDropZones

`Flare.Components.IDE.DockDropZones`

Body regions a dock group offers as drop targets. The tab row is a separate reorder surface.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No body region; tabs can still be reordered and activated. |
| `Into` | `1` | The center of the group: move the item into the group. |
| `Start` | `2` | The inline-start edge: split before the group. |
| `End` | `4` | The inline-end edge: split after the group. |
| `Top` | `8` | The block-start edge: split above the group. |
| `Bottom` | `16` | The block-end edge: split below the group. |
| `All` | `31` | All five body regions. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDockWorkspace`
